meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents. Use when the user needs to interact with websites, including navigating pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data, testing web apps, or automating any browser task. Triggers include requests to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data from a page", "test this web app", "login to a site", "automate browser actions", or any task requiring programmatic web interaction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI自动操控浏览器完成网页交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要自动化浏览器操作，如填表单或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions with AI agents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, scraping, or form filling

howto.what: Claude 可通过命令行自动化浏览器操作：打开网页、填写表单、点击按钮、截图、提取数据等。工作流程：打开页面→获取元素编号→用编号交互→重新获取状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求“打开网站”“填写表单”“点击按钮”“截图”“提取数据”等浏览器交互任务时触发。

say.note: Claude 会导航到该网站并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我填写登录表单，用户名是 admin，密码是 pass
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框并填入信息。
Claude 会返回页面的 title 标签内容。

howto.what_en: Claude can automate browser tasks via command line: opening pages, filling forms, clicking buttons, taking screenshots, extracting data. Workflow: navigate → snapshot for element refs → interact using refs → re-snapshot.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user asks to "open a website", "fill out a form", "click a button", "take a screenshot", "scrape data", or any browser interaction task.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will navigate and capture a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in the login form with username admin and password pass.
say_en.note: Claude will locate inputs and enter credentials.

say_en.text: Get the title of the current page.
say_en.note: Claude will return the page title.
